newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell slightly to 3.018 billion yuan from 3.110 billion yuan with the 30-day contract the most actively traded.
Volume remained heavy with both state-run banks and non-bank financial institutions actively trading, traders said.
This was partly due to the approach of the monthly settlement date for financial institutions, they said.
Traders said securities houses were the biggest borrowers as the stock markets had recently been quite active.
Short-term financial centres in Shanghai and Beijing, money brokerages run by the central bank, were the major lenders.
Traders said they expected trading to continue to be active on Wednesday, with the rates moving around current levels.
